OUR CASE DOES NOT CONTRADICT IT: our expectation is spec 4.8, 'the working-day start sits at the left edge with a 30 to 60 minute buffer', which is the same primary rule. SV-8915 adds two fallbacks the specification does not state. No change owed to our case; the fallbacks are a product question if anyone wants them tested.
